fact: Al Wasl University (Dubai) offers a CAA-accredited Bachelor in Library and Information Sciences, listed with status Active.
Al Wasl University's Bachelor in Library and Information Sciences is reported as launched in 2020.
The American University in the Emirates (Dubai) launched a Master of Information & Library Science through its College of Computer Information Technology.
UAE University's Department of Cognitive Sciences offers majors in Psychology and Linguistics and a minor (not a major) in Cognitive Science.
MBZUAI announced its first undergraduate programme, a BSc in Artificial Intelligence with Business and Engineering streams, in March 2025.
MBZUAI's first undergraduate cohort numbered 115 students from more than 2000 applications (about 5% accepted).
MBZUAI lists undergraduate tuition of USD 45000 per year for students entering in Fall 2025.
University of Sharjah offers a four-year BSc in Artificial Intelligence in its College of Computing and Informatics.
Canadian University Dubai announced a BSc in Artificial Intelligence in July 2025.
Al Ain University introduced a BSc in Artificial Intelligence and Robotics and an MSc in AI in 2025.
The UAE National Strategy for Artificial Intelligence 2031 (announced October 2017) includes attracting and training talent for AI-enabled jobs among its objectives.
From the 2025-26 academic year, AI is taught as a subject in UAE public schools from kindergarten to Grade 12, delivered by about 1000 teachers.
The Mohammed bin Rashid Library in Dubai opened to the public on 16 June 2022 with nine specialised libraries and over one million print and digital books.
UAE University has adopted an Artificial Intelligence Agenda 2025-2031 covering education and research.

In this desk search (Nov 2026), no UAE institution was found offering a dedicated undergraduate degree combining Cognitive Science and AI. This is a search result, not proof that none exists; confirm against the CAA programme register.
